This is read by BOTH halves: scripts/ingest-raw.mjs in CI (which has no database) and, later,
M2's loader locally. One file so the two cannot drift.
`_global` is a pseudo-country for sources that are not country-partitioned, following the same
underscore convention as raw/_canary. It is deliberately not a real ISO code so it can never be
mistaken for one or joined against `countries`.
